name: Compression Domain Rendering
definition: A rendering technique that reconstructs volumetric data on the GPU per-fragment by fetching indices from a compressed RGB index texture, using dependent texture fetches to retrieve difference vectors from codebook textures, and adding them to the mean value.
summary: Compression Domain Rendering reconstructs volumetric data on the GPU via dependent texture fetches, rendering directly from compressed data to minimize memory transfer and avoid full decompression.
